jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Engineer II - Industrial Automation with Data Analyst

Primary Purpose of the Role

Thales is expanding its presence in India through the development of a Group Engineering Competence Centre (ECC), reinforcing its position as a leader in all its markets. Launching in early 2019 in Bengaluru, the ECC will expand Thales footprint in its core business areas and cement its long-standing relationship with India.

Strong of more than 500 engineers as of today, ECC will grow to >1200 by 2029.

This role is part of the Industrial Process Engineering function. The position is Industrial Automation with Data Analyst responsible for Dashboard Creation, Maintenance, Upgradation.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

  • Industrial Automation Data Collection You are responsible for the design of industrial systems and standards, as well as their integration with other systems across Thales sites, with a focus on data collection and connectivity

  • Data Analyst - You are responsible for data collection, analyzing, and visualizing data to help organizations make data-driven decisions. A key part of the role is designing and maintaining dashboards that display KPIs, trends, and insights.

Detailed Responsibilities below:

  • Design automation layers to enable real-time machine data collection for performance tracking, predictive maintenance, and OEE improvement.

  • Implement protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, etc.) for secure and reliable data acquisition.

  • Work closely with site engineering, IT/OT teams, production, and quality to gather requirements and deliver integrated solutions.

The position is based in Bangalore.

  • Promote collaboration within the team IPE

Opportunities

  • The chance to work in an organization that is driving towards building a structured engineering footprint in line with Thales growth and competitiveness ambition

  • The chance to be in contact with people having different cultural background from all across the world

  • A young and enthusiastic team looking to take new interesting projects on board

  • A working environment that facilitates professional development through continuous learning, close collaboration within teams and a solution-oriented attitude

title: Software Engineer II
jobDescription:
Software Engineer II

POSITION PURPOSE:

We are hiring a hands-on Backend Engineer to build, operate, and own the microservices that power FarmRise a platform that puts agronomic advice directly into the hands of smallholder farmers. This is not a role where you hand off deployment and operations to someone else: you will design the service, write the code, own the AWS infrastructure it runs on, and be the first call when it breaks in production.

You will work across services spanning user onboarding, agronomy, commodity pricing, news/events, and third-party integrations. We are looking for someone who treats a production incident or an ambiguous requirement as their problem to solve, not someone waiting to be assigned a ticket.

What You Will Own End to End

  • Service design architecture: design and evolve Java + Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs consumed by the FarmRise mobile app and internal platforms; make and document trade-offs on data modeling, service boundaries, and API contracts.
  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS): own the full runtime your services live on ECS/Fargate for compute, RDS/Aurora Postgres for persistence, S3 for storage, CloudWatch/CloudTrail for logs and audit, SNS/AmazonMQ for messaging, CloudFront for delivery, ElastiCache for caching plus IAM, VPC/networking, and secrets management. You provision, tune, and troubleshoot this infrastructure yourself, not through a separate DevOps team.
  • Async event-driven systems: design event/queue-based workflows on RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) producers, consumers, retry and dead-letter handling, idempotency, and back-pressure for resilient, decoupled processing.
  • Data layer: design Postgres schemas, indexes, and queries for correctness and performance at scale; own migrations and query optimization as data volume grows.
  • Observability reliability: instrument services with structured logging and metrics (Datadog/CloudWatch), define SLOs, set up alerting, and drive scalability, availability, and fault-tolerance practices across the platform.
  • CI/CD quality: maintain build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, JUnit); keep test coverage, code quality gates, and deployment safety nets healthy.
  • Security: apply JWT-based auth patterns and platform security conventions; treat data privacy and secure coding as a default, not an afterthought.

What You Will Do Day to Day

  • Ship backend features and services against explicit expectations for reliability, latency, and cost not just it works on my machine.
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS, including scaling decisions, cost tuning, and incident response when something breaks in production.
  • Debug production issues end-to-end using logs, metrics, and traces and own the fix, not just the diagnosis.
  • Build and evolve shared libraries, interceptors, and API standards that improve developer experience across the platform.
  • Use AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) deliberately to speed up code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation while following secure coding and data privacy practices.
  • Partner directly with product, mobile, and platform teams to turn ambiguous requirements into scoped, reliable services and push back when a request is not the right build.
  • Review code from other engineers with a focus on quality, performance, security, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE:

Required:

  • 4 10 years of backend engineering experience building and operating production services not just writing code that others deploy.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design, with real production systems you can walk through in depth.
  • Proven, hands-on AWS experience: you have personally deployed, scaled, and debugged services on ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, S3, and CloudWatch including IAM and VPC/networking troubleshooting. You do not need someone else to touch the AWS console for you.
  • Solid grounding in microservices patterns service boundaries, contract design, versioning, and scaling services independently.
  • Practical, past experience with Postgres: schema design, indexing, and query optimization on production workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with messaging/async systems, especially RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) including retries, dead-letter queues, and idempotent consumers.
  • Practical CI/CD experience: Git-based workflows, build tooling (Maven/Gradle), code quality gates (SonarQube), and unit testing (JUnit) as a default practice, not an exception.
  • Strong, independent debugging skills across logs, metrics, and distributed systems you can own a production issue from alert to resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation, applied with secure coding and data privacy discipline.
  • Ownership mindset: a demonstrated track record of taking a problem statement, scoping it, and driving it to production without needing constant direction.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with JWT auth flows and API gateway/routing patterns.
  • Experience with caching strategies and HTTP caching concepts (ETags, max-age headers).
  • Exposure to serverless patterns (Lambda), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and additional data stores (Redis/NoSQL).
  • Experience operating services with centralized logging/monitoring stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Prior experience in Agri-tech, agri-inputs, rural commerce, or similar domains serving high-scale, low-connectivity users.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) Consultant with strong coding experience and a solid understanding of SAPs cloud technologies.   • Use SAP Cloud Integration, SAP API Management, and SAP Extension Suite to extend and integrate enterprise applications.

  • Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful delivery of SAP BTP projects, including planning, execution, and monitoring.
  • Manage project risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation.

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation, including design documents, coding standards, and user manuals.

jobDescription:
Digital Marketing Specialist Social Media & Performance Marketing

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Work Mode: On-site

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content, boosting posts, or increasing followers.

We need someone who understands why people stop, watch, engage, enquire and eventually become customers.

Your job will be to combine Content + Consumer Psychology + Data + Paid Advertising to grow our social media presence and generate quality leads.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and execute our Instagram, Facebook and YouTube growth strategy
  • Plan content calendars with the creative team
  • Identify content topics based on audience interests, search behaviour and market trends
  • Work closely with videographers, editors and content creators
  • Analyse which Reels/videos are performing and why
  • Improve hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs and content positioning
  • Run and optimize Meta Ads & Google Ads
  • Create lead-generation and remarketing campaigns
  • Track leads from Ad Landing Page/WhatsApp Enquiry Conversion
  • Conduct A/B tests on creatives, audiences, hooks and offers
  • Build retargeting audiences
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets
  • Prepare simple weekly/monthly performance reports

The Skills We're Looking For

1. Social Media Strategy

You should understand:

  • Instagram Reels
  • Facebook
  • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
  • Organic content growth
  • Content distribution
  • Audience building
  • Engagement & retention
  • Social-media trends
  • Competitor research

You shouldn't simply tell us:

“This Reel got 50,000 views.”

You should be able to explain:

“Why did it get 50,000 views, where did viewers drop, what made people share it, and how can we repeat that success?”

2. Performance Marketing

Hands-on experience with:

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook & Instagram Ads
  • Google Ads
  • Lead-generation campaigns
  • Conversion campaigns
  • Remarketing
  • Lookalike/custom audiences
  • Campaign budgeting
  • Creative testing
  • A/B testing
  • Cost-per-lead optimization

You should understand metrics such as:

CPL • CTR • CPC • CPM • Conversion Rate • ROAS • CAC

But more importantly, you should understand what action to take when those numbers aren't performing.

3. Analytics

Working knowledge of:

  • Meta Business Suite
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • YouTube Analytics
  • Google Trends
  • Pixel & conversion tracking
  • UTM tracking

We want someone who can turn data into decisions, not simply download reports.

4. Consumer Psychology

This is extremely important for us.

You should be curious about:

Why does someone click?

Why does someone watch one Reel for 3 seconds and another for 40 seconds?

Why does someone save a video but not enquire?

Why does one advertisement generate cheap but poor-quality leads while another generates fewer but serious customers?

Understanding attention, curiosity, trust, objections, desire and buying behaviour will be a major advantage.

Content Marketing

You don't necessarily have to shoot or edit every video.

Topic Hook Content Angle Thumbnail CTA Distribution Retargeting

You should be comfortable telling the team:

“Video achha hai, but opening ke first 3 seconds weak hain. Let's test another hook.”

That's the mindset we're looking for.

Someone who is:

Analytical + Creative + Curious + Result-Oriented

Someone who doesn't wait for instructions for everything.

If a campaign isn't working, you should naturally want to know:

“Why?”

If a Reel suddenly performs 10X better than usual:

“Why?”

If competitors are growing faster:

“What are they doing differently?”

That curiosity matters to us.

Someone whose entire strategy is:

“Sir, 500 ka boost kar dete hain.”

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between boosting a post and building an actual marketing system.

About the role
Job Overview
Were looking for an AI engineer with genuine depth across three areas that most people only have one of: classical ML, LLMs, and computer vision . Our problems dont fit neatly into one bucket. A single workflow might involve a vision-language model extracting fields from a 40-year-old scanned sale deed, a ranking model deciding which retrieved records matter, and an LLM-powered agent reasoning over the results to flag title risks.
Youll work on systems that are already in production and used by real customers making high-stakes property decisions - not research prototypes.


What Youll Work On
  • Document understanding at scale. Fine-tuning VLMs (Qwen, Nemotron, Kimi family models using LoRA adapters) for classification, layout analysis, and field extraction across Indian property documents - handwritten, scanned, stamped, multilingual, and frequently degraded.
  • Classical ML where it earns its keep. Ranking and retrieval (BM25 and learned rankers), entity resolution across noisy government records, fraud/anomaly detection, and calibration of model confidence for legal-grade outputs.
  • LLM agents in production. Improving our conversational agents for land-records search and title diligence - tool design, context management, evaluation harnesses, and cost/latency optimization.
  • Evaluation and data infrastructure. Designing annotation taxonomies, building eval sets that reflect real document distributions, and closing the loop from production failures back into training data.
What Were Looking For
  • 6 10 years building ML systems in production, with shipped work across at least two of: classical ML, LLMs/NLP, computer vision.
  • Strong fundamentals - you can reason about why a model fails, not just swap in a bigger one. Comfort with the full lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight models ( LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, preference optimization ) or training CV/document models (detection, layout, OCR pipelines).
  • Practical LLM engineering: prompt and context design, structured/constrained outputs, RAG, agent tool design, building evals that actually predict production quality.
  • Solid Python and the engineering discipline to write code teammates can build on. Experience with PyTorch and the modern inference stack ( vLLM or similar) is a plus.
  • Pragmatism. You pick the simplest approach that solves the problem - sometimes thats a gradient-boosted tree, sometimes its an 8B VLM with constrained decoding.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Indic languages, OCR for degraded documents, or multilingual NLP.
  • Work on agentic systems, multi-step tool use, or LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Exposure to legal, fintech, or other high-stakes domains where correctness and provenance matter.
  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling or published applied work.


Your First 90 Days
Days 1 30: Ground truth. Ship a small improvement to a production model or eval in week one. Read real documents and real transcripts - sale deeds, ECs, agent conversations - until you understand why this data breaks naive approaches. Own one document types extraction quality end to end.
Days 31 60: Own a model surface. Take full ownership of one pipeline - say, an extraction adapter for a major state or the retrieval/ranking layer - including its eval set, error analysis, and a measurable quality lift youve shipped to production.
Days 61 90: Shape the roadmap. Propose and begin executing a meaningful bet - a new adapter architecture, a better eval harness, a classical-ML component that cuts cost or error - backed by evidence from your first 60 days. By now your judgment should be influencing what the team builds next, not just how.


Why This Role
  • Frontier applied-AI problems with no playbook - nobody has solved document intelligence for Indian land records.
  • Direct impact: your models decide whether a familys property purchase is safe.
  • Small, senior team with high ownership; youll shape architecture, not just implement tickets.
  • Backed by Y Combinator and top investors, with real revenue and real customers.
Why Join Landeed
  • High-Impact Role : Shape the AI backbone of a cutting-edge real estate platform that transforms how millions access property information.
  • Fast-Growing Startup : Join a dynamic, collaborative environment in Hyderabad, where your ideas and expertise will be valued.
  • Competitive Compensation : Receive a fixed salary plus equity , aligning your success with the company s growth.
  • Professional Growth : Work with talented peers and stay at the frontier of AI/ML innovations in NLP and information retrieval.


About the interview
We move fast - the full loop takes 5-7 days, and well give you a decision within 48 hours of your final round.
  • Intro call (30 min). Mutual fit, your background, what youre looking for. Well walk you through the problem space.
  • Technical deep-dive (60 min). A past ML system you shipped, interrogated properly: data, modeling choices, failure modes, what youd redo. Were probing for depth and honesty, not buzzwords.
  • Work sample (take-home or paired, your choice, ~3 hrs). A scoped problem on real (anonymized) property-document data e.g., design and partially implement an extraction + eval approach.
  • System design + eval round (60 min). Design a production pipeline for a Landeed problem end to end, including how youd measure it. Expect pushback.
  • Founder conversation (45 min). Values, ambition, and your questions about where the company is going.


About Landeed

This is a full-cycle sales role. You do it all, with demo support available when you need it.

title: AI Adoption & Enablement Manager (Part Time)
jobDescription:
Required Qualification

- 12+ years of professional experience.
- Meaningful experience in Finance Operations, Business Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services, BPO or a comparable operational environment.
- Strong understanding of administrative and transactional finance processes; experience across areas such as AP, AR, billing, collections, cash application, reconciliations and reporting is highly desirable.
- Strong hands-on experience using Generative AI tools, particularly Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, in a business environment.
- Demonstrated ability to identify practical AI use cases and translate technology into improvements in day-to-day work.
- Strong training, facilitation, coaching, presentation and stakeholder-engagement capabilities.
- Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Ability and willingness to work flexible shifts when required to engage teams across global time zones.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote / work-from-home environment.

Preferred Qualification

Preferred / Advantageous
- Experience leading technology adoption, change management, process improvement or transformation initiatives.
- Experience in a global shared-services, professional-services, insurance, financial-services or business-services organization.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate or Power Platform.
- Understanding of AI agents and workflow automation.
- Lean, Six Sigma, process-improvement or change-management experience/certification.
- Experience developing learning programs, communities of practice or champion networks.
- Understanding of responsible AI, data security and appropriate enterprise use of Generative AI.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- Passionate and genuinely curious about Generative AI and how it can transform work.
- A sophisticated hands-on user of ChatGPT, Copilot and related tools - not someone whose knowledge is primarily theoretical.
- Understands business processes and operational realities, not just technology.
- Can quickly understand someone s work and identify realistic opportunities where AI can help.
- Can turn complex AI capabilities into simple, compelling and practical examples.
- An excellent presenter, facilitator and coach who can engage both frontline employees and senior executives.
- Comfortable influencing people without direct authority.
- Commercially minded and focused on measurable outcomes.
- Self-motivated, adaptable and effective in a remote, global working environment.
- Continuously experiments, learns and stays current as AI capabilities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Adoption Practical Enablement
- Lead practical adoption of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and other approved Generative AI tools across global teams.
- Deliver engaging, hands-on workshops, demonstrations, learning sessions, office hours and individual coaching.
- Teach employees how to use AI effectively for their actual work rather than relying on generic AI examples.
- Develop role-based prompting techniques, reusable prompts, templates, workflows and practical guidance.
- Help employees progress from basic AI usage to integrating AI into their normal day-to-day work.
- Make Generative AI understandable and accessible to employees with different levels of technical proficiency.

2. Finance, Operations Shared Services Use Cases
Work directly with business teams to identify and implement practical AI opportunities across activities such as:
- Accounts Payable and invoice-related activities
- Accounts Receivable, collections and cash application
- Billing and invoicing
- Reconciliations and data validation
- Financial and operational reporting
- Administrative and shared-services activities
- Email drafting, summarization and communication management
- Meeting preparation, notes and follow-up actions
- Research, information synthesis and document review
- Standard operating procedures, process documentation and knowledge management
- Process analysis, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
The individual must understand the underlying process and business objective before recommending an AI solution.

3. Use-Case Discovery Scaling
- Partner with teams to discover high-value AI opportunities and prioritize them based on practicality and business impact.
- Convert business problems into practical Copilot, ChatGPT or AI-enabled approaches that employees can use themselves.
- Build and maintain a reusable library of proven AI use cases, prompts, playbooks and examples.
- Develop function-specific AI playbooks for Finance, Operations, Shared Services and other corporate functions.
- Identify successful practices in one team or region and scale them across the global organization.
- Partner with technology or automation teams when a use case requires a more advanced solution, workflow or agent.

4. Global Engagement Facilitation
- Work with employees and leaders across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions.
- Operate flexibly across shifts and time zones to support a global workforce.
- Build credibility with both operational employees and senior business leaders.
- Adapt communication, examples and facilitation style for different cultures, functions and levels of AI maturity.
- Create and support a global network of AI champions or power users who can reinforce adoption locally.
- Communicate AI concepts in simple business language and inspire employees to experiment responsibly.

5. Change Management Continuous Improvement
- Drive behavioral change so that employees move from learning about AI to consistently using it to improve their work.
- Identify barriers to adoption and develop practical interventions to address them.
- Create communications, learning journeys and engagement activities that sustain adoption.
- Capture and communicate success stories that demonstrate tangible business value.
- Bring a continuous-improvement mindset and challenge traditional ways of working where AI can provide a better approach.

6. Measurement Business Impact
Success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply the number of training sessions delivered. The role will establish and track measures such as:
- AI adoption and active usage
- Employee proficiency and confidence
- Number of practical use cases implemented
- Hours of work or capacity saved
- Reduction in repetitive/manual activities
- Productivity, quality or cycle-time improvements
- Use cases successfully replicated across teams or regions
- Employee and stakeholder feedback
- Documented examples of measurable changes in how work is performed

[overview] Role Overview
We are seeking a senior, highly practical and passionate AI Adoption Enablement Manager to accelerate the effective use of Generative AI across our global organization. The role requires a distinctive hybrid skill set: deep practical knowledge of tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, meaningful experience in Finance Operations and/or Business Operations, strong process thinking, and the ability to engage, coach and influence employees across functions, cultures and geographies.
This is not a traditional AI engineering role and it is not simply an AI training role. The successful candidate must understand how work is actually performed and be able to translate AI capabilities into practical, relevant ways of improving day-to-day activities. The goal is measurable change in how people work - not just awareness or training attendance.
What Makes This Role Different
Knowing how to use AI tools is only one part of the requirement. We are looking for someone who can combine AI knowledge with real operational experience. For example, the individual should be able to sit with an Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Shared Services or administrative team, understand the work being performed, identify where AI can help, demonstrate a practical solution, coach employees to use it effectively, and measure the resulting improvement.
[/overview]

Senior Business Analyst

Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:
  • Reviewing payer contracts, amendments, and fee schedules
  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues
  • Calling out false positives and explaining why something is not a true issue. If something looks technically correct but operationally wrong, you are expected to stop it.
  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.
  1. Act as the RCM Counterweight in Vendor Engagements. You will actively participate in vendor evaluations, technical reviews, and edge-case discussions. You will:
  • Ask uncomfortable but necessary questions
  • Spot hand-wavy answers around contracts or EDI
  • Distinguish between can build, has built, and is guessing
  • This role is critical to holding vendors accountable and ensuring delivery meets operational standards.
  1. Help Carry the Long-Term Platform Vision Forward. While the MVP starts with underpayments, the platform is designed to evolve toward:
  • Broader reimbursement correctness (denials, old AR, charge capture)
  • Recommendation intelligence and outcome monitoring

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world s hardest, highest-impact problems. About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.
You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.
What You ll Own Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration
  • Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
  • Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
  • Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .
  • Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.
Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations
  • Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
  • Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
  • Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .
  • Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.
  • Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.
Kafka Streaming Infrastructure
  • Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.
  • Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.
  • Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
  • Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
  • Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
  • Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.
What You Bring
  • 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .
  • Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform - Azure, AWS, or GCP - with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.
  • Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language .
  • Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.
Good to Have
  • Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator .
  • Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK .
Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.
  • Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.
  • Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.
  • Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .
  • Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.
What Success Looks Like
  • Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.
  • Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.
  • Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.
  • Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.
  • Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.
  • Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.
Why This Role
This is an opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed data infrastructure at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. Loyalty Juggernaut is seeking a Product Manager to identify, validate, launch, and scale new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled offerings. We design and run loyalty and customer-engagement programs for some of the world's most recognized brands. Growth doesn't only come from the platform - it comes from new offerings - new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled practices that clients need before anyone has packaged them. This role finds such opportunities and turns them into real businesses.

As a Product Manager in the Loyalty Performance Management (LPM) team, you will own the full lifecycle - from an initial idea or market signal through research, business case, offer design, pilot, commercialization, and practice development. After launch, you will act as the business owner for the incubated practice - setting its roadmap, sharpening the proposition and delivery model, watching commercial performance, and building the repeatability it needs to become a standalone unit.

This is not a traditional software product management role. It blends market strategy, services design, product marketing, commercial ownership, and venture incubation. You are as comfortable building a market landscape and modeling unit economics as you are shaping a client-ready offer, creating sales enablement, and leading cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities

Opportunity discovery & market validation

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new-service ideas.
  • Conduct structured market, customer, category, and competitor research.
  • Define the ideal customer profile, economic buyer, priority use cases, customer pain points and desired outcomes.
  • Lead interviews and working sessions with clients, prospects, sales, delivery teams, product leaders, subject-matter experts, and partners.

Business case, pricing & investment recommendation

  • Define pricing, packaging, contract structure, and monetization options - fixed fees, subscriptions, usage or outcome-based fees, revenue share, and hybrid models.
  • Translate assumptions into an executive recommendation and a clear investment ask; track actual performance against the approved case and update the forecast as evidence improves.

Service product design & productization

  • Turn a validated opportunity into a repeatable, sellable offer with a defined customer, outcome, scope, deliverables, methodology, timeline, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design the end-to-end service blueprint: client journey, discovery and design activities, delivery workflows, roles and RACI, governance, data and technology requirements, quality controls, SLAs, and KPI framework.
  • Translate service requirements into a prioritized roadmap for platform, data, analytics, automation, and internal tooling in partnership with product and engineering.

GTM & sales enablement

Launch, roadmap & practice incubation

Graduation to a standalone unit

  • Commercial and financial fluency - business-case development, pricing and packaging, scenario modeling, unit economics, margin, forecasting, and investment recommendations.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Shared Data/ODSP Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on-shift technical delivery for tenant-to-tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics-driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre-checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third-party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign-off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long-running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

  • Delivered at least one production tenant-to-tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands-on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Teams-associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi-geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS-102) or SharePoint specialization, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises.
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action-oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re-run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign-off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

title: Tech Enabled Designer
jobDescription:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Role Overview

Within the CTO organization, the Tech-enabled Designer plays a key role in accelerating innovation by transforming concepts into tangible, testable experiences.

Working at the intersection of design, technology, and innovation, the role focuses on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and exploration of emerging interactions (notably AI-driven experiences), enabling teams to quickly validate ideas and demonstrate value.

The Tech-enabled Designer contributes to bridging the gap between design intent and technical feasibility, supporting innovation teams in building compelling and credible Proofs of Concept (POCs).

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Prototyping & Experimentation

  • Design and develop interactive prototypes (Figma advanced prototyping, coded prototypes, AI-driven experiences)
  • Create realistic POCs and demos to support concept validation and stakeholder engagement
  • Explore new interaction paradigms (AI, conversational interfaces, agent-based experiences)

Technology Exploration & Integration

  • Continuously assess and experiment with emerging technologies (Generative AI, prototyping tools, automation)
  • Identify and demonstrate relevant use cases aligned with innovation initiatives
  • Contribute to defining new interaction patterns for future products and services

Design-Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with innovation engineers and technical teams
  • Contribute to feasibility discussions and propose viable alternatives

Acceleration of Validation Cycles

  • Enable rapid testing with users and stakeholders through tangible artifacts
  • Support innovation projects with high-impact deliverables for:
    • internal decision-making
    • executive presentations (CTO / Business Lines)
    • co-innovation workshops

Profile & Qualifications

Education

B.Design and M.Design

Experience

  • 4-6 years of experience in UX design, interaction design, or digital product design
  • Proven experience in prototyping beyond static design (interactive, coded, or experimental)

Skills

Design & UX

  • Strong UX and interaction design capabilities
  • Ability to design complex user flows and systems
  • Experience with service-oriented or system-level thinking is a plus

Prototyping & Technology

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (interactive prototyping)
  • Familiarity with code-based prototyping
  • Experience with AI tools is highly valued

Collaboration & Mindset

  • Strong collaboration skills with international teams (France / USA / Singapore)
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, product)
  • Ability to operate in uncertain and exploratory environments
  • Proactive, curious, and experimentation-driven mindset
  • Strong communication and storytelling abilities
  • Experience in conducting design workshops and Interactive sessions

Key Interfaces

  • Innovation Engineers (R&T, CTO teams)
  • Strategic Designers (value proposition, framing)
  • Service & UX Designers (experience design)
  • Product & Business stakeholders

Deliverables

  • Interactive prototypes (Figma and/or coded)
  • Innovation POCs (including AI-driven concepts)
  • Value Proposition artifacts
  • Demonstrators for internal and external stakeholders
  • Experimental interaction models and design patterns

Why Join Us

You will be part of a Strategic Design team within the CTO organization, working on cutting-edge innovation topics (AI, emerging technologies, future user experiences).

This position offers a unique opportunity to:

  • shape future products and services upstream
  • work directly with innovation and engineering experts
  • experiment with emerging technologies in a highly creative environment
  • have visible impact on strategic decisions

At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Tech Enabled Designer
jobDescription:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Role Overview

Within the CTO organization, the Tech-enabled Designer plays a key role in accelerating innovation by transforming concepts into tangible, testable experiences.

Working at the intersection of design, technology, and innovation, the role focuses on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and exploration of emerging interactions (notably AI-driven experiences), enabling teams to quickly validate ideas and demonstrate value.

The Tech-enabled Designer contributes to bridging the gap between design intent and technical feasibility, supporting innovation teams in building compelling and credible Proofs of Concept (POCs).

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Prototyping & Experimentation

  • Design and develop interactive prototypes (Figma advanced prototyping, coded prototypes, AI-driven experiences)
  • Create realistic POCs and demos to support concept validation and stakeholder engagement
  • Explore new interaction paradigms (AI, conversational interfaces, agent-based experiences)

Technology Exploration & Integration

  • Continuously assess and experiment with emerging technologies (Generative AI, prototyping tools, automation)
  • Identify and demonstrate relevant use cases aligned with innovation initiatives
  • Contribute to defining new interaction patterns for future products and services

Design-Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with innovation engineers and technical teams
  • Contribute to feasibility discussions and propose viable alternatives

Acceleration of Validation Cycles

  • Enable rapid testing with users and stakeholders through tangible artifacts
  • Support innovation projects with high-impact deliverables for:

    • co-innovation workshops

Education

B.Design and M.Design

Experience

Skills

Design & UX

  • Ability to design complex user flows and systems
  • Experience with service-oriented or system-level thinking is a plus

Prototyping & Technology

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (interactive prototyping)
  • Familiarity with code-based prototyping
  • Experience with AI tools is highly valued

Collaboration & Mindset

  • Strong collaboration skills with international teams (France / USA / Singapore)
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, product)

  • Proactive, curious, and experimentation-driven mindset
  • Strong communication and storytelling abilities
  • Experience in conducting design workshops and Interactive sessions

You will be part of a Strategic Design team within the CTO organization, working on cutting-edge innovation topics (AI, emerging technologies, future user experiences).

Orgzit is a SaaS software product business. We help small and mid-sized businesses implement systems in their sales, operations, and accounting functions with CRM & workflow automation software solutions.


Our unique value proposition is our no-code technology advantage, which enables us to offer customised business software solutions that are the easiest to use and implement in the shortest time.

Orgzit was founded in 2016 by Pavan Verma and Nitin Verma to solve the problems of SMBs they experienced firsthand in their family and friends' businesses. Over the past 9+ years, we have served more than 100 businesses. Our customers rely on our product daily to automate their sales and operational processes and grow their businesses.

We are a member of two accelerators: Upekkha, the #1 accelerator for SaaS businesses in India, and Nasscom Startups. We are a profitable business and are investing in growing 100% every year for the next five years.


Our customer, Carolyn Arote of CAVH from Florida, USA, says, My team is able to track all sales-related things on Orgzit. It has been worth its weight in Gold.


Our team member Karan Asthana says, “Orgzit has a very open, transparent, and friendly culture. You get to work closely with visionary founders and build a world-class business. It is the best place for someone who wants to learn and become a master of their domain.”

Watch this video to discover why you should join us and be part of building a new generation of business software.


Visit our website at https://orgzit.com to learn more about us.

We're looking for a highly organised, trustworthy Executive Assistant who can manage accounts, HR, recruitment, and founder support with equal ease. The ideal Executive Assistant is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling multiple workstreams without dropping the ball. Above all, they should be someone who takes ownership, learns fast, and wants to grow with a young, fast-moving startup.

  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple workstreams (accounts, HR, recruitment, admin) without missing tasks.
  • Proactive Ownership: Anticipates needs before being asked and takes initiative to close gaps.

  • Discretion & Integrity: Trusted with confidential information, including founder communications, compensation data, and team matters, and handles it with judgment and professionalism..

Experience

Benefits

Why Join Us


As a small, bootstrapped, fast-growing startup, we strive to provide a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our team members’ contributions. We provide an unparalleled environment to professionals looking to grow in their careers:

  • Growth Opportunities: Take on new responsibilities, learn, and grow personally and professionally

jobDescription:
About us
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You'll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There's no one like you and that's why there's nowhere like RSM.

Position Summary
The Solutions Architecture Manager is a highly proficient, hands-on solution architect for RSM custom solutions. This role owns end-to-end microservice and API architecture for assigned solutions, defines Domain-Driven Design boundaries and event-driven patterns on Azure Service Bus, and sets engineering standards across React frontend and .NET/Python backend teams. The role operates with growing autonomy across the custom solutions estate and represents designs in architecture reviews.

Key Responsibilities
  • Translate business and product requirements into end-to-end solution designs for RSM custom solutions spanning multiple frontend and backend services.
  • Adapt quickly to evolving engineering priorities, market trends, and emerging technologies; rapidly evaluate new technology areas and produce proof-of-concepts, technical assessments, and analysis reports to support timely decision-making and delivery expectations.
  • Design microservice and API architectures for custom-built solutions; define service boundaries using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
  • Architect event-driven integration patterns using Azure Service Bus; define message schemas, topic/subscription models, and error-handling strategies.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across frontend (React) and backend (.NET / Python) teams.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, observability) are embedded into all solution designs.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews for new features, technical initiatives, and third-party integrations within assigned solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), high-level design (HLD) documents, and API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and engineering leads to shape technical roadmaps.
  • Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and conduct design and code reviews.
Qualifications & Experience
  • 10+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with at least 5 years in a solution architect role on complex, multi-service platforms.
  • Expert-level proficiency in designing microservices architectures and RESTful / GraphQL APIs.
  • Deep hands-on experience with React (frontend architecture) and .NET and/or Python (backend services).
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL database platforms, including data modeling, partitioning, indexing, performance optimization, and selection of appropriate persistence patterns for distributed, cloud-native applications.
  • Working knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including monitoring strategies, distributed tracing, telemetry standards, and production diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
  • Advanced understanding of Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed systems patterns.
  • Hands-on knowledge and experience in designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions using AI agent frameworks, Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search, and LLMs/SLMs.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.

jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together, theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -
We are seeking a Senior Account Executive (Enterprise) to drive growth by owning the full sales cycle - from prospecting and pipeline creation to closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. This is a role for a proven hunter and closer who thrives in competitive environments, engages C-level executives with confidence, and consistently delivers results. You ll be selling a category-defining solution, working with ambitious mid-market and growth-stage companies, and playing a key role in shaping our revenue engine.
Where youll leave your mark
  • Own and manage the end-to-end sales process for Enterprise accounts with an ACV of $50k to $250k
  • Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of new logos while expanding within existing customers.
  • Lead consultative, value-driven sales conversations with VP and C-level executives.
  • Build and execute territory plans to systematically open new opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and Marketing to accelerate pipeline.
  • Accurately forecast and manage deals through disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas and performance targets.
The kind of builder were looking for -
  • 8+ Yrs is B2B Sales experience / Account Executiveroles withinSaaS, Software, or Technology Services, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation.
  • 4+ years of experience selling the within the region, including territory planning and regional sales ownership.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, or Consultative Selling.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual new business quotas , with consistent high performance.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, discovery, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXO-level stakeholders and close complex deals.
How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

About TYLsemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
  • Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.


Culture Team: How We Work No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  • US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

Were not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. Were building to win.

What We Value
  • Ownership mindset. Youre not here to execute someone elses roadmap. Youre here to define it.
  • Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesnt fly here.
  • Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people whove shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
  • Low ego, high standards. We dont care about titles or politics. We care about results.
The Ask

If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

Were asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Heres why you should:

  • The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what were building.
  • The team has done this before. Weve built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isnt our first rodeo.
  • The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
  • The work is consequential. Youre not optimizing someones ad click-through rate. Youre building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

We are looking for a DFT Engineer with solid hands-on experience to own key aspects of DFT implementation and verification for advanced SoC designs. You will drive DFT features to achieve high test coverage while optimizing for test time and power.

What You ll Do

  • Develop and implement DFT architecture including scan insertion, compression, and hierarchical DFT.
  • Generate and optimize ATPG patterns for various fault models (stuck-at, transition, path delay, etc.) and perform failure diagnosis.
  • Design, integrate, and verify MBIST controllers, repair mechanisms (BISR), and memory test strategies.
  • Implement and verify Boundary Scan (BSCAN), JTAG, and IJTAG (IEEE 1687) infrastructure.
  • Perform DFT static timing analysis (STA), constraint development, and timing closure in collaboration with PD teams.
  • Execute DFT verification including pre-silicon simulations and Gate-Level Simulation (GLS).
  • Support silicon bring-up, ATE (Automated Test Equipment) pattern validation, and post-silicon debug.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (RTL, Verification, Physical Design, Test Engineering) to resolve DFT issues.
  • Analyze coverage metrics and improve test quality.

What We re Looking For

  • Bachelor s/Master s degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering.
  • 4-7 years of experience in DFT for SoC/ASIC designs.
  • Strong proficiency in ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, scan compression,BSCAN and IJTAG.
  • Experience with industry tools for DFT insertion, pattern generation, and simulation.
  • Hands-on silicon bring-up and debug experience.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python,Tcl, Perl) for automation.
